description: This file defines an internal interface IGrainTimerRegistry in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which provides methods for recording the creation and disposal of grain timers.

classes.name: IGrainTimerRegistry
classes.description: An internal interface for recording grain timer creation and disposal events.

methods.name: OnTimerCreated
methods.description: Signals to the registry that a grain timer was created.

methods.name: OnTimerDisposed
methods.description: Signals to the registry that a grain timer was disposed.
